edges.reason: Constructor writes the token name into _name.
Constructor writes the token symbol into _symbol.
Constructor initializes _decimals to 18.
name() reads _name.
symbol() reads _symbol.
decimals() reads _decimals.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_setupDecimals writes _decimals.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender, so authorization derives from caller input.
transfer uses msg.sender via _msgSender as the debited account.
approve uses msg.sender via _msgSender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] for the spender allowance.
increaseAllowance indexes _allowances with _msgSender().
decreaseAllowance indexes _allowances with _msgSender().
_msgData returns msg.data without validation.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
approve invokes the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes _approve to update the allowance.
increaseAllowance invokes _approve with the increased allowance.
decreaseAllowance invokes _approve with the decreased allowance.
_transfer calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates.
_mint calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Electra constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
Electra constructor uses the initialSupply constant as the mint amount.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance deduction.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance increments.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply decrements.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub to reduce the allowance.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add to grow the allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub to shrink the allowance.
SafeMath.sub(a,b) delegates to the message variant sub(a,b,errorMessage).
SafeMath.div(a,b) delegates to the message variant div(a,b,errorMessage).
SafeMath.mod(a,b) delegates to the message variant mod(a,b,errorMessage).
_transfer performs _balances[sender].sub(amount).
_transfer performs _balances[recipient].add(amount).
_mint performs _totalSupply.add(amount).
_mint performs _balances[account].add(amount).
_burn performs _balances[account].sub(amount).
_burn performs _totalSupply.sub(amount).
transferFrom performs _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount).
increaseAllowance performs _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].add(addedValue).
decreaseAllowance performs _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].sub(subtractedValue).
SafeMath.add computes c = a + b with an overflow require.
SafeMath.sub computes c = a - b after require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul computes c = a * b with an overflow require.
SafeMath.div computes c = a / b after require(b > 0).
SafeMath.mod computes a % b after require(b != 0).
balanceOf parameter account indexes _balances.
transfer parameter recipient is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer parameter amount is forwarded to _transfer.
approve parameter spender is forwarded to _approve.
approve parameter amount is forwarded to _approve.
transferFrom parameter sender is forwarded to _transfer and _approve.
transferFrom parameter recipient is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom parameter amount is forwarded to _transfer and the allowance subtraction.
increaseAllowance parameter spender is forwarded to _approve.
increaseAllowance parameter addedValue is added to the allowance.
decreaseAllowance parameter spender is forwarded to _approve.
decreaseAllowance parameter subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance.
_transfer parameter sender indexes _balances.
_transfer parameter recipient indexes _balances.
_transfer parameter amount is used in the balance add and sub.
_mint parameter account indexes _balances.
_mint parameter amount is added to supply and balance.
_burn parameter account indexes _balances.
_burn parameter amount is subtracted from balance and supply.
_approve parameter owner indexes _allowances.
_approve parameter spender indexes _allowances.
_approve parameter amount is stored in _allowances.
Constructor parameter name is written into _name.
Constructor parameter symbol is written into _symbol.
SafeMath.add parameter a participates in the checked addition.
SafeMath.add parameter b participates in the checked addition.
Local variable c holds the result of a + b in SafeMath.add.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter only indexes _balances for the balanceOf lookup and is fully represented by the balanceOf function node.
The recipient parameter is passed straight into _transfer and carries no independent semantics beyond the transfer entry point.
The amount parameter flows unchanged to _transfer and is subsumed by the transfer function node.
The spender parameter is forwarded to _approve without transformation.
The amount parameter is forwarded to _approve and defines only the approve call.
The sender parameter is used only inside transferFrom for allowance and transfer bookkeeping.
The recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer within transferFrom.
The amount parameter drives the transfer and allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is passed directly to _approve.
addedValue is consumed by the allowance addition operation.
The spender parameter is passed directly to _approve.
subtractedValue is consumed by the allowance subtraction operation.
The sender parameter only indexes the _balances mapping inside _transfer.
The recipient parameter only indexes the _balances mapping inside _transfer.
The amount parameter feeds the balance subtraction in _transfer.
The account parameter only indexes _balances inside _mint.
The amount parameter feeds the supply and balance additions in _mint.
The account parameter only indexes _balances inside _burn.
The amount parameter feeds the balance and supply subtractions in _burn.
The owner parameter only indexes the _allowances mapping.
The spender parameter only indexes the _allowances mapping.
The amount parameter is stored directly into _allowances.
The name parameter is assigned to _name during construction.
The symbol parameter is assigned to _symbol during construction.
The a operand participates directly in the checked addition c = a + b.
The b operand participates directly in the checked addition c = a + b.
The local result c is defined solely by the a + b operation and its overflow require.
